workflow_secrets.name: CODECOV_TOKEN
workflow_secrets.purpose: Upload unit coverage and test-result reports to Codecov.
workflow_secrets.rotation: Create a replacement upload token in Codecov, update the GitHub Actions secret, verify one CI upload, then revoke the previous token.

workflow_secrets.name: NVIDIA_API_KEY
workflow_secrets.purpose: Run an explicitly dispatched interoperability smoke against the hosted NVIDIA NIM OpenAI-compatible API.
workflow_secrets.rotation: Rotate the key in NVIDIA, update the managed source configuration, verify Config Sync and one bounded live smoke, then revoke the previous key.

workflow_secrets.name: OPENCODE_ZEN_API_KEY
workflow_secrets.purpose: Run explicitly dispatched OpenCode Zen interoperability and repository-owned skill evaluations.
workflow_secrets.rotation: Rotate the key in OpenCode Zen, update the managed source configuration, verify Config Sync and one bounded live smoke, then revoke the previous key.

environments.name: dev
environments.auth_model: GitHub Environment secrets synchronized from the managed source configuration; no secret value is committed to the repository.
environments.rotation: Rotate at the provider, update the source secret manager, verify Config Sync, and run the manual provider smoke before revoking the old credential.

environments.name: npm-publish
environments.auth_model: GitHub OIDC trusted publishing to npm; the workflow grants id-token: write and does not use a static npm credential.
environments.rotation: No npm credential is stored. Revoke or replace npm trusted-publisher configuration and GitHub environment access if the trust relationship changes.
